triplets.evidence_span:
GPT-5 models remained more stringent in aspects of critical evaluation (tended to provide slightly lower

issues detected by human evaluators, including contradictions and methodological concerns.

triplets.subject: R Trustworthiness Evaluation To

for research quality assessment or trustworthiness evaluation to identify potential limitations, sources of bias, and
methodological concerns, and then incorporate these findings into the appraisal process of a more generalist model such
as GPT-5.
